rows.label: tlk70000153_10_msg0001
rows.name:
I never thought anyone would appear
who could defeat all those absurdly
strong Golden Monsters!

rows.label: tlk70000153_10_msg0002
tlk70000153_10_msg0003
rows.name:
It seems having my eternity
unexpectedly cut short wasn't entirely
pointless.

rows.label: tlk70000153_10_msg0004
rows.name:
Because thanks to you, I got
to meet strong warriors
like yourselves!

rows.label: tlk70000153_10_msg0005
rows.name:
[ML:Feeling kind=Think ] And above all, you generously bought
information I'd outrageously
overcharged for.

rows.label: tlk70000153_10_msg0006
rows.name:
I have nothing more to sell you,
but if you wish to see my treasures,
come whenever you like!
